scope.selection: All six final ThinkFlow 40dfa30 jobs and all six Pi 1.0.1 reference jobs; no lower candidate results substituted.
scope.excluded: 18 exploration jobs and 6 request replays remain exclusively in exploration.json; no duplicated billing rows here.
scope.review_status: All 12 deliveries, original evidence and all 54 exported source files independently verified.

method.usage: Independent sums from original raw_usage; prompt includes cache, output includes reasoning. Unknown request usage stays unknown; reported totals with unknown requests are lower bounds.
method.tool_batches: Tools declared/executed within each TF model turn are counted together. Information batch size is not local parallelism. Successful mutation before stream_finished requires tool_completed event earlier in the same ordered event timeline. No estimated API savings relative to Pi are derived.
method.review: Independent actual artifacts, final checks and handoff reviewed in docs/reviews/efficiency-final-20261110.md; original accepted values are preserved.
method.privacy: No request bodies, raw model text/thinking, identity header values, credentials or private absolute artifact paths.
method.tool_choice: Value preserved where meter recorded it; older Pi records do not record this field and remain unknown.
